stem: Which statement BEST explains why the trees appear on the surface of the lake?

options.label: A
options.text: The trees produce light that reflects off the water.

options.label: B
options.text: Light reflects off the trees and reflects off the water.

options.label: C
options.text: The trees refract light that then reflects off the water.

options.label: D
options.text: Light refracts from the water and is reflected off the trees.

visual_elements: A black and white photograph showing trees along the edge of a lake with their clear reflection visible on the surface of the lake.
